targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() AS flows FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ScopeName LIKE '%netflow%' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['source.address'] AS src, formatReadableSize(sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['flow.io.bytes']))) AS bytes, count() AS flows FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ScopeName LIKE '%netflow%' GROUP BY src ORDER BY sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['flow.io.bytes'])) DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT LogAttributes['destination.port'] AS dport, LogAttributes['network.transport'] AS proto, count() AS flows, formatReadableSize(sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['flow.io.bytes']))) AS bytes FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ScopeName LIKE '%netflow%' GROUP BY dport, proto ORDER BY flows DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Firewall denies and threats (UniFi syslog, CEF)

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, LogAttributes['cef_name'] AS event, LogAttributes['cef_severity'] AS severity, LogAttributes['cef_extension'] AS details FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'unifi-syslog' AND (positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'block') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'drop') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'deny') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(Body, 'threat') > 0) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body, SeverityText AS level FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'unifi-syslog' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000
